=== .github/workflows/odd.yml (hosted-workflows)
# Imported from .github/workflows/odd.yml by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: odd
on:
  push: {branches: ['*']}
steps:
  #  NEEDS A PERSON: some ${{ }} expressions below are left as written
  lint:
    image: docker.io/library/python:latest
    run: |
      # golangci/golangci-lint-action@v6
      golangci-lint run
      # codecov/codecov-action@v4
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: a third-party action ran here: codecov/codecov-action@v4'; exit 1
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: this step used the shell pwsh'; exit 1
      # original:
      # Write-Host hello
      # NEEDS A PERSON: this step had the condition `github.event_name == 'push'` and now always runs
      if [[ -n "$X" ]]; then echo yes; fi
      echo "v=1" >> $LAUNCHWAY_OUTPUTS
      echo "PATH=$PWD/bin:$PATH" >> $GITHUB_ENV
      echo ${{ format('{0}-{1}', github.repository, vars.REGION) }} ${{ github.actor }}
  #  NEEDS A PERSON: this job ran on windows-latest and now runs in a Linux image
  win:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    run: |
      echo windows
  reuse:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    run: |
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: this job called a reusable workflow: ./.github/workflows/shared.yml'; exit 1
  dyn:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    run: |
      echo dyn
  cond:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    run: |
      echo conditional
